item.description: The sync option builder has incorrect parameter handling in the wrapper function. Tests are failing because the wrapper function expects no arguments but receives one when called from the decorator.
item.contract: The option builder wrapper function should accept arbitrary arguments and keyword arguments (*args, **kwargs) to match the expected signature for the decorator pattern.

item.description: Async generators are not supported in synchronous builders. The error occurs when trying to use async generators with the sync option builder.
item.contract: The sync option builder should detect and reject async generators with a clear error message, preventing runtime confusion.

item.description: Async generators are not supported in synchronous builders. Similar to async_option, the sync result builder rejects async generators with an error.
item.contract: The sync result builder should detect and reject async generators with a clear error message, preventing runtime confusion.

item.description: The seq builder fails with AttributeError when processing list iterators (like those from Seq.empty()). The error 'list_iterator' object has no attribute 'send' indicates that the builder doesn't properly handle non-generator iterables.
item.contract: The seq builder should properly convert list iterators and other non-generator iterables into proper generators before processing.

item.description: Async generators are not supported in synchronous builders. The sync result builder rejects async generators with an error message.
item.contract: The sync result builder should detect and reject async generators with a clear error message, preventing runtime confusion.
